query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_levels` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `renterLevel` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `renterTotalRentals` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterTotalKm` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterAvgRating` decimal(3,2),
  `renterLevelUpdatedAt` timestamp,
  `renterScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterScoreUpdatedAt` timestamp,
  `renterCancellations` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterLateReturns` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterDisputes` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterReports` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `renterRankCity` int,
  `renterRankState` int,
  `renterRankNational` int,
  `hostLevel` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `hostTotalRentals` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostTotalEarnings` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostAvgRating` decimal(3,2),
  `hostAvgResponseHours` decimal(6,2),
  `hostCancellationRate` decimal(5,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostLevelUpdatedAt` timestamp,
  `hostScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostScoreUpdatedAt` timestamp,
  `hostCancellations` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostComplaints` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostReports` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hostRankCity` int,
  `hostRankState` int,
  `hostRankNational` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_levels_userId_unique` (`userId`),
  KEY `idx_user_levels_userId` (`userId`),
  KEY `idx_user_levels_renter_score` (`renterScore`),
  KEY `idx_user_levels_host_score` (`hostScore`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_achievements` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `achievementKey` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `context` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'renter',
  `unlockedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_achievements_userId_key` (`userId`, `achievementKey`),
  KEY `idx_user_achievements_userId` (`userId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `platform_goals` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `metricType` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `targetValue` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `currentValue` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `unit` varchar(32),
  `color` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#22d3ee',
  `period` varchar(64),
  `startDate` timestamp,
  `endDate` timestamp,
  `isActive` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);
